entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer for AI agents. It supports multi-level memory for users, sessions, and agent states, utilizing temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval available via managed cloud or self-hosted Apache-2.0 OSS.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and tiered loading to achieve a 91% token reduction. It archives sessions as editable Markdown files and utilizes a three-tier loading system (Abstract, Overview, Details) to improve task-completion gains.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system that implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across over 25 LLM providers and multiple storage backends. It achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and offers client implementations in Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: An open-source platform that provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversation data locally on CPU, supporting custom ontologies without requiring an LLM API key.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and performs multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, videos, and code via MCP server and plugins.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that combines keyword retrieval, semantic search, and synthesis with citations. It exposes a typed knowledge graph to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections for extracting supported references.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes-compatible honcho-self-hosted wrapper. Implemented as a FastAPI server, it supports managed, local CLI, or Docker deployments with SDKs for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like commit, branch, and merge for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system for sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency AI memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for local storage. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates filesystem-first traces and outcome-gated context bundles to assist agents with complex tasks. It provides entry points for Hermes and MCP clients while supporting various providers including Anthropic and vLLM.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over 35 coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, without requiring a background server. It enables agents to search months of past sessions via MCP or CLI, processing nearly 20,000 sessions in under 18 seconds.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private, cross-session memory persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server and includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur serves as a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent portability. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and local embeddings, accessible via an MCP server integration.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that synchronizes state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine captures session decisions and preferences using a local GGUF observer model without cloud dependencies. It retrieves information through a combination of BM25, vector search, and cross-encoder reranking.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw by reordering text and multimodal context to improve prefix-cache sharing. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling across vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It tracks contradictions, prevents duplicates through idempotent writes, and uses a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve persistent knowledge across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching session logs to prefetch context into a local SQLite-vec cache. Built for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it uses GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack for Hermes Agent that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single system. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by implementing local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that stores durable agent information in plain Markdown rather than native memory formats. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts for agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that addresses persistent recall issues by supporting real, immediate event deletion. It features an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every memory prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and handle x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services in a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide capability routing for Hermes Agent. It facilitates knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal while supporting automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session-end snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and search. It supports advanced retrieval techniques including configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval modes, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, alongside automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory that identifies stale information and contradictions using 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs from markdown files, utilizing a local git repository to track and revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the DeepSeek Harness runtime. It enables agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is designed for compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms to bolster defensive and offensive capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams via natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes and offers both a CLI and an MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It integrates x402 payments and escrow with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process. It features five optional voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for prose refinement.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos. It integrates with Hermes and Claude Code, providing a bilingual dashboard to inspect session traces and evolving skill sets.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The library operates without telemetry or mandatory accounts and provides ready-to-paste exports for various other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and identifies potential blind spots in its own reporting.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers guides for VPS production and automation alongside skills compatible with the agentskills.io standard. It supports localized integrations for platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These developer tools follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. Supported integrations include CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This suite provides official API integrations and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. It includes a specialized video suite with eight distinct skills for polling and webhook management.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting these skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It supports multiple AI models and provides integrity verification for execution traces.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, featuring commerce capabilities powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client employs a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It uses a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project provides agent-driven scheduling and system design via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces such as CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for grounded investigation. It includes a Python-based goal engine for persistent state management and a systematic protocol for causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code and Cursor. The toolkit orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides specialized tools for worktree recovery and skill scaffolding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts for Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs .tape or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, web apps, and libraries, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while monitoring official frontmatter specifications for drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This collection provides skills for live social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes a dedicated MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication and workspace Postgres integration.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and processing e-commerce materials. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can correctly route file operations and verify compatible interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is designed for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This quality assurance tool tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows developers to visualize their consumption and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 40 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 distinct skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring founder approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for schema mismatches or contradictory directions. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and exports findings in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining unique local tools and instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operation using free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configurations, credentials, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the transfer of SOUL.md and skills while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It functions without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for Hermes Agent via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux facilitates one-click switching between various API providers. It centralizes configuration management for multiple tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks through built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent. It enables remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram while maintaining user approval and file access controls.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JS, this interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for web and mobile users. The layout features three panels dedicated to chat, session management, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app supports local backends and remote API connections for chatting with Hermes Agent. It features a streaming markdown UI with token tracking and provides management for 14 toolsets, memory systems, and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard supports multiple runtimes including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness while offering unified configuration for 10 communication platforms. It includes a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, memory browser, and an MCP catalog for comprehensive agent management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes an embedded terminal alongside native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX/Markdown rendering and provides dedicated tools for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables site-aware drafting and opt-in browser control with support for multi-agent switching and synced chat histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and mobile management for skills, scheduled tasks, and workspaces.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, real-time chat with tool call visualization, and an MCP server control plane. It utilizes the ZOO Swarm Monitor to track agent health and manage kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs while building search indexes locally to maintain privacy.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments. It uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop environment includes 100 tools for tasks like TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation. It features a built-in workflow engine and runs via portable Python and Node.js environments contained within a single folder.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface offers real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It provides management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard that provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual store with over 50 curated skills. The interface supports streaming SSE responses and allows for rapid model switching.
